high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for the Jeep Compass, specifically highlighting its availability with an automatic transmission. The ad is sponsored by Jeep India, as indicated at the top left corner of the image. Car Model: The main focus of the image is the Jeep Compass, a green-colored SUV. It is positioned prominently in the center, showcasing its front and side profile. The car appears sleek and modern, with a bold grille and sharp lines that give it a sporty look. Text: The text "NEW COMPASS" is displayed at the top left, emphasizing the model.
